title: termalin-web
description: Run commands and read/write files on your servers over Termalin's keyless tunnels (hosted MCP).
summary: Run commands and read/write files on your servers over Termalin's keyless tunnels (hosted MCP).
offersHint: Run commands and read/write files on your servers over Termalin's keyless tunnels (hosted MCP). · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://termal.in/api/v1/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <API key> — create one at termal.in/account (API keys & MCP section)

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer <API key> — create one at termal.in/account (API keys & MCP section)

toolsPreview.name: hosts_list
toolsPreview.description: List the servers reachable through Termalin (your tunnel agents). Returns id, name, whether the server is online, and the default login user. Use the id with ssh_exec.

toolsPreview.name: generate_password
toolsPreview.description: Generate a strong random password — handy when creating a user or setting a password on a server. Returns the password only; nothing is stored.

toolsPreview.name: ssh_exec
toolsPreview.description: Run a single shell command on one of your servers and return its combined output. Runs keyless over Termalin's tunnel — no SSH key, and the server needs no open inbound port.

toolsPreview.name: sftp_list
toolsPreview.description: List a directory on one of your servers over SFTP. Returns each entry's name, whether it's a directory, size and modified time. Runs keyless over Termalin's tunnel, like ssh_exec.

toolsPreview.name: sftp_read
toolsPreview.description: Read a text file from one of your servers over SFTP and return its contents. Files over 512 KB or non-text (binary) files are refused — use ssh_exec (e.g. sed/tail) for those.

toolsPreview.name: sftp_write
toolsPreview.description: Create or overwrite a text file on one of your servers over SFTP. 'content' is written as UTF-8. Capped at 512 KB; for binary uploads use a terminal/scp instead.
